tasks.title: Create an account from name, email and password
tasks.description: registerUser + validateSignup in server/src/controllers/authController.ts, wired in routes/authRoutes.ts; unique lower-case email, 8-character minimum password, 201 summary without secrets.

tasks.title: Hash and email the verification link
tasks.description: createSecureToken/hashToken from server/src/utils/tokens.ts, 24-hour expiry on the user, verifyEmailTemplate and sendEmail with the Resend/SMTP/console providers.

tasks.title: Verify an address once and refuse a replayed link
tasks.description: verifyEmail matches the token hash with an unexpired row, sets isVerified and clears the token fields so the same link cannot be used twice.

tasks.title: Resend verification without revealing account state
tasks.description: resendVerification answers the same generic message for unknown, verified and unverified addresses, and only emails the unverified case.

tasks.title: Issue a JWT and a revocable session row
tasks.description: generateToken (random jti, 7-day expiry) plus createSession storing the SHA-256 token hash, user agent and IP; issueSession builds the sign-in response. Session schema and indexes in server/src/models/sessionModel.ts.

tasks.title: Make login failures uniform and reject operator payloads
tasks.description: validateLogin plus { email: { $eq: String(email) } } lookups and the single 401 'Invalid email or password' for every failure; 403 with requiresVerification for an unverified address.

tasks.title: Re-check the session on every authenticated request
tasks.description: protect in server/src/middleware/authMiddleware.ts: bearer parsing, JWT verification, isValid session lookup by token hash, throttled lastLoggedIn write, user attached without the password.

tasks.title: Invalidate exactly the session that logs out
tasks.description: logoutUser marks the matching session invalid and always answers 200, so two sign-ins in the same second stay independent.

tasks.title: Request a reset link without an enumeration oracle
tasks.description: forgotPassword stores a hashed token with a 1-hour expiry and answers the same message for known and unknown addresses; only the newest link for an account stays valid.

tasks.title: Reset the password and end every session
tasks.description: resetPassword consumes the token once, saves the new password, clears ssoOnly and invalidates every session of the account.

tasks.title: Change the password from settings
tasks.description: changePassword requires the current password, keeps the calling session and revokes the other sessions of the account (server/src/controllers/profileController.ts).

tasks.title: List the account's active sessions
tasks.description: listSessions filters with activeSessionFilter, sorts the current session first and returns no token material.

tasks.title: Revoke one session or all other sessions
tasks.description: revokeSession scopes the update to the caller's own user id and answers 404 otherwise; revokeOtherSessions keeps the calling session and reports how many were revoked.

tasks.title: Resolve identity, role, permissions and actions
tasks.description: getCurrentUser returns the workspace, role, permission keys and deriveActions output, and self-heals a membership without roleId (owner -> Product Owner, otherwise Viewer).

tasks.title: Store the session in one place and react to a 401
tasks.description: client/src/utils/session.ts owns the token and user keys and wipes the query and service-worker caches; client/src/utils/api.ts clears the session and redirects to /login?expired=1; useAuthGuard protects pages.

tasks.title: Save onboarding answers and create the first workspace
tasks.description: saveOnboarding validates the answers, generates a unique slug and a 12-hex invite code, assigns the Product Owner system role and sets the workspace active; the second call returns the existing workspace.

tasks.title: Apply the auth and sensitive rate limits
tasks.description: authLimiter on /api/auth plus sensitiveLimiter on login, forgot-password, resend-verification, the profile password change and the two-factor routes, with JSON error bodies (server/src/app.ts).

tasks.title: Keep credentials and tokens unrecoverable
tasks.description: bcrypt pre-save hook and matchPassword in userModel, SHA-256 digests for every token, and the toJSON transform that deletes password and token fields.

tasks.title: Validate every auth payload
tasks.description: Validation chains on all mutating auth routes and String() casts before queries, so malformed payloads answer 400 instead of 500.

tasks.title: Cover the flows with unit and integration tests
tasks.description: server/src/__tests__/security.test.ts and sendEmail.test.ts for the pure helpers, server/src/__integration__/{auth,sessions,passwordReset,resendVerification,profile}.test.ts for the flows, and the client AuthPage, SecurityPage and session tests.

tasks.title: Run the repository quality gates
tasks.description: pnpm --filter server typecheck && pnpm --filter server test, pnpm --filter client typecheck && pnpm --filter client test && pnpm --filter client lint, pnpm --filter client build (CON-402).
